summary: Backend testing of invited-user active_workspace_id fix. Created 6 tests covering _accept_pending_invites behavior + /api/auth/me + /api/workspaces + /api/workspaces/switch + hotfix data verification for artemarble34@gmail.com. All 6 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: _accept_pending_invites uses pending[0]['workspace_id'] deterministically — if a user has multiple pending invites, the 'first' is Mongo insertion order which is fine but could be surprising; consider ordering by invited_at desc or asc explicitly.
server.py is 2195 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, workspaces, transactions, reports).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed users, workspaces, invites and sessions and clean them up in teardown. Existing artemarble34@gmail.com data was NOT modified — only read to verify hotfix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_invited_active_workspace.py verifies (1) _accept_pending_invites sets active_workspace_id for first-time invitees, (2) users without invites keep personal (None) unchanged, (3) existing active_workspace_id is not overwritten, (4) /api/auth/me returns shared workspace_id + correct role, (5) /api/workspaces/switch works between personal & shared, (6) hotfix data for user_77ef5bc81196 is intact. Note pytest.ini uses xdist by default — run with `-o addopts=''` to disable. Tests import server.py directly (no need to start uvicorn separately, backend URL used only for HTTP endpoint tests).
rca of the issue: Root cause: _accept_pending_invites did not set active_workspace_id on newly-invited users. _resolve_workspace_context falls back to personal workspace when active_workspace_id is None, so invitees landed on their empty personal workspace as 'owner'. Fix (verified): after accepting pending invites, if user has no active_workspace_id, set it to pending[0]['workspace_id']. Existing behavior preserved: users with an existing active_workspace_id (e.g. previously logged in as own owner) are not overwritten; users without invites keep their None (which still resolves to personal via fallback).
